synopsis: Part 1: Hiroshima, 1955. A family from Hiroshima struggles to come to terms with their survival of the atomic bombing of their city. The protagonist is Minami Hirano, about 20 years of age. Fumiyo Kôno examines this question in her outstanding book—an award-winning, widely-discussed masterpiece!
